notes.subject: tsedeke
notes.rationale: צדיק e phetolwa ka 'tsedeke' ho ya ka molao wa D2, eseng 'ya lokileng' feela

notes.subject: ya hlokolihang
notes.rationale: נקי 'ya hlokolihang' — sefaha se aroloa ke ya hlokolihang, eseng mmopi wa sona

notes.subject: o tla arola
notes.rationale: יחלק bolela 'ho arola/ho aha dihlotse'; KJV 'shall divide', mme mehlala ya bohale e ka 'ho aha' — ho arola ke ho tlwaelehileng

translation: A ka e lokisa, mme ya tsedeke o tla e apara, mme ya hlokolihang o tla arola ⟨את⟩ sefaha.
